note: Provenance of every source file in this directory. text/ holds mechanical plain-text extractions (python html-stripping for the .xhtml/.html files, pdftotext -layout for the PDFs) made on 2026-10-01 for quoting and search; the files listed here are authoritative over them.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act), as published in OJ L, 12.7.2024
sources.note: Fetched from the Publications Office cellar (Accept: application/xhtml+xml, eng) because eur-lex.europa.eu served a bot-challenge page to every route on 2026-10-01. Original text as published; the amendments made by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 are applied by reading the next file.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of 8 July 2026 (the AI 'digital omnibus'), OJ L 24.7.2026
sources.note: Replaces Article 50(7) and adds Article 111(4) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689. In force on the third day after publication.

sources.title: Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content (final, 10 June 2026)
sources.note: A voluntary code under Article 50(7). The Commission and the AI Board have confirmed it is 'an adequate voluntary tool' (https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/code-practice-ai-generated-content). It binds only signatories.

sources.title: Commission Guidelines on the transparency obligations of providers and deployers of AI systems, C(2026) 5054 final, Brussels 20.7.2026
sources.note: Non-binding interpretive guidance. Used only to state the readings of 'standard editing' and 'substantially alter' that the encoding takes as inputs, never to compute them.

sources.title: Engrossed Second Substitute House Bill 1170, Chapter 167, Laws of 2026 (Washington)
sources.note: Session law as passed; takes effect 1 February 2027 (s.9). Not yet codified in RCW.

sources.title: California SB 1000 (Becker, 2025-2026), enrolled text; approved by the Governor 30 September 2026
sources.note: The page served the ENROLLED version (presented to the Governor 2 September 2026), which is the text approved on 30 September 2026 (bill status page, checked 2026-10-01). No chapter number was shown on leginfo on 2026-10-01. Urgency statute: in effect on approval. Amends Bus. & Prof. Code ss. 22757.1, 22757.2, 22757.3, 22757.4, 22757.5; adds 22757.4.1.

sources.title: California AB 853 (2025), Stats. 2025, ch. 674
sources.note: Source of Bus. & Prof. Code s. 22757.3.1 (large online platforms, operative 1 January 2027) and s. 22757.6 (chapter operative 2 August 2026), neither of which SB 1000 amends.
